motion.name: portrait
motion.value: intro 44 steps; ~4.4k points at 2.0 CSS px (±25%), alpha 0.66 light / 0.78 dark; scroll s = scrollY / 0.9vh, t = 0.9·s^1.2, rise 0.14·s, fade smoothstep over s 0.12–0.55

motion.name: cjk-typing
motion.value: hold 84 frames (caret 12 on / 12 off), erase 1 char per 3 frames, gap 14 frames, type 1 char per 6 frames
motion.purpose: 陈星昊 typed and erased in six hands on the shared clock after the name settles.

motion.name: vitex-sampler
motion.value: intro 30 frames; switch 9 frames forward, hold at peak, 15 frames back
motion.purpose: ViTeX scene change as a noise round trip.

motion.name: campus-sampler
motion.value: arrival 22 frames from t = 0.72; hand-over 28 frames on a scroll threshold (thirds of a 330svh pinned track): forward to peak by 40%, mix under the noise, back to t = 0; tint and gain crossfade; text opacity 375ms steps(9)
motion.purpose: Campus hand-overs in the screen band: timed noise round trip, school-tinted, never through white; every school rests at t = 0.

motion.name: globe-sampler
motion.value: 36-frame diffusion of visitor points; slow yaw 0.0036 rad/frame
motion.purpose: Visitor marks arrive from noise onto the globe.

motion.name: theme-threshold
motion.value: 12 frames (500ms) step-end grain-threshold mask on ::view-transition-new(root); 128px field tiled at 256px
motion.purpose: Light/Dark switch sampled into place, never faded.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Samplers render once at t = 0, no clock loop, Chinese name still without caret, instant theme swap, scroll-behavior auto.

motion.name: no-webgl
motion.purpose: Text shown immediately, no portrait, ViTeX video plays, screen band shows static tinted plates, globe hidden.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Denoising Trajectory"**

The page behaves like one diffusion sampling run. Every state that changes arrives as a short noise-to-signal trajectory: per-pixel Gaussian grain (PCG hash into Box-Muller, WebGL2) resolving coarse shape first and crisp edges last, on the cosine ᾱ schedule, while a KaTeX readout of the live timestep counts down to t = 0. The name and an authored particle profile are sampled out of noise together in the first viewport; the profile diffuses back into noise as the reader scrolls. ViTeX scene switches, the campus hand-overs, the visitor globe and the Light/Dark switch use the same grammar. When a trajectory ends, its grain is gone: the settled page is clean ground.

The material is an off-white plate in light and a near-black void in dark, printed in near-black or bone ink. Structure is carried by hairlines, tabular numerals and notation, with one container: a flat, square plate-2 tint panel that holds each publication and each project. Density is editorial and generous: long section air, a 12-column grid with margin headings at wide widths, and one full-bleed dark screen band where the campuses resolve, each filtered in its school's colour. 陈星昊 is a second, quieter voice that follows the surname on its baseline, typed and erased in six hands on the shared clock. The single cobalt accent is instrumentation: it lights only on a live t readout or a visitor mark, and rests to graphite when t reaches 0. Positional markers (rail, school index) are ink.

Confirmed rejections: bordered, rounded or shadowed cards, pills, decorative shadows, small eyebrows or kickers above headings, glow, gradients on the accent, neon or cyber styling, standing grain or texture at rest, filters or blur on text, and any hover motion beyond colour and underline changes.
keyCharacteristics: Gaussian noise is the only transition vocabulary; it exists only while something is being sampled, and the ground is clean at rest.
One shared 24 fps clock; every sampler, the Chinese name's typing and every stepped CSS transition land on its frames.
Hairline instruments (1px rules, 9px ticks, 1px underlines, 3×16px ink markers) and one flat plate-2 tint panel instead of boxes.
Geologica at light weights with negative tracking; KaTeX Computer Modern for every number that means t; six calligraphic and print hands for 陈星昊.
Light and dark are both first-class and follow the system until the visitor chooses.
Reduced motion and no-WebGL are complete, still pages, never degraded ones.

rules.name: The Live-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means "t > 0 right now" or "a visitor was here". Position ("you are here" on the rail or the school index) and anything at rest, including the colophon x₀, is ink or graphite.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every neutral has a void counterpart in the same role; never introduce a light-only or dark-only colour outside the screen band.

rules.name: The Band-Only School Colour Rule
rules.body: The school colours filter photographs inside the screen band and appear nowhere else.

rules.name: The Light Hand Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page is heavier than 550 (the author's own name). Headings sit between 300 and 400; the one heavier display line is the 500 venue header, because the venue is what a reader checks first. Otherwise size and tracking make hierarchy, not weight.

rules.name: The Notation Rule
rules.body: Any number that is a timestep or schedule value is KaTeX_Main at 1.08em of its readout, with a 2.9ch minimum width, so it never reflows while it counts.

rules.name: The Three Glyph Rule
rules.body: CJK faces ship subset to the three glyphs of 陈星昊 and nothing else; a new CJK string means a new subset, never a full font.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The menu sheet is the only surface allowed a cast shadow. Anything else that needs separation gets a hairline or the plate-2 tint.

rules.name: The Clean Ground Rule
rules.body: At rest the ground is flat plate or void. Grain and particles exist only while a trajectory runs; the hero canvas clears and stops once the name settles, every campus settles at t = 0, and the portrait never draws below the hero rule or behind 陈星昊.

dos: Do make every new state change a noise-to-signal trajectory on the shared 24 fps clock; content samplers also show a live t readout.
Do clear and stop a sampler when its trajectory ends; the ground at rest is flat plate or void, and every campus rests at t = 0.
Do keep the accent to live readouts (t > 0) and visitor marks, plus focus ring, caret-color and selection; return readouts to graphite at t = 0. Position markers are ink.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines (rule / rule-strong) and ledger rows; when a unit needs to stand apart, give it a square plate-2 panel.
Do set numerals tabular and timesteps in KaTeX_Main at 1.08em with a 2.9ch minimum.
Do keep headings at weight 300–400 with negative tracking (-0.015em to -0.04em); the venue header at 500 is the one exception.
Do size stepped CSS transitions to whole frames (41.667ms multiples) with `steps(n)`.
Do reveal text by opacity only.
Do ship the still path and the no-WebGL path as finished pages.
Do define every new neutral for plate, void and, if it can appear there, the screen band.
Do subset any CJK face to the glyphs it sets and self-host it.
donts: Don't use bordered, rounded or shadowed cards, pills or badges; the only container is the square plate-2 panel, and radius is 0 except the 2px focus outline.
Don't add shadows beyond the menu sheet.

Don't place small eyebrows or kickers above headings; supporting lines (dates, meta, notes) go below the title. The display-size venue header that opens a publication panel is the only line above a title.
Don't animate hover with lifts, scales, parallax or cursor followers; hover changes colour or underline only.
Don't give the accent a glow, gradient, fill or rest state, or use it for position markers.
Don't blur or filter text, in reveals or anywhere else.
Don't crossfade or slide where the world samples; no crossfades for theme or scene changes, and campus hand-overs cross under the noise, never through white.
Don't leave grain, particles or texture standing on the page at rest, or let the portrait draw below the hero rule or behind 陈星昊.
Don't use the school colours outside the screen band.
Don't use uppercase labels or letter-spaced small caps.
Don't run a second animation clock or free-running requestAnimationFrame outside gl.ts.
